Resolve shared naming components from a VPC

Source: R/naming.R
resolve_naming_components.Rd

Computes the CRS/zone, grid-snapped spatial extent, region, and year for every feature in a VPC - the data needed by both the AdV and NWFVA filename builders (adv_filename(), nwfva_filename()). Standard-agnostic: the two builders differ only in how they assemble these components into a filename string.

Usage

resolve_naming_components(vpc, region = NULL, from_csv = NULL, epsg = 25832L)

Arguments

vpc

A VPC object as returned by resolve_vpc().

region

Optional character vector of two-letter region codes. If NULL, the region is automatically inferred from file bounding boxes via detect_region().

from_csv

Optional path to CSV file for year determination.

epsg

Integer. EPSG code used as fallback CRS when a file does not contain a valid CRS.

Value

A list with files, zone, minx/miny/maxx/maxy, tilesize, region, year, date_source, ext_suffix - one value per file (recycled for scalar inputs like an explicit region).
